{{Removed|date = 10th of February 2024}} {{For|the [[Golden Body Guards 1]]|[[Golden Body Guards 2]]|its normal counterpart, the [[Body Guard]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Golden Body Guard |image-static = GBodyGuard.png |image-dynamic = GoldenBodyGuardDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Golden Crook Boss]] |type = Humanoid |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]10 |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]50s (Level 1)
[[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]40s (Level 2) |damage_type = Single Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]2 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.625 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]20 |speed = 4 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden Body Guard''' was a [[Units|unit]] spawned by the [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 1 or Level 2. In the game, the '''Golden Body Guard''' was referred to as just '''Body Guard''', though it has been referenced here as '''Golden Body Guard''' to differentiate itself from other [[Crook Boss]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]] units. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Golden Body Guard''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemies. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range. The '''Golden Body Guard''' had a spawnrate of 50 seconds, 40 seconds if the [[Golden Crook Boss]] was Level 2. There was a limit of one unit per [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Levels 1 and 2, limiting the amount of '''Golden Body Guards''' it could spawn. ==Appearance== The '''Golden Body Guard''' had pale skin. It had black legs, and wore brown cotton gloves, a black buttoned tuxedo with short yellow sleeves that had dark brown outlines and grey shoes. It also wore a black necktie and was faceless. It also had a yellow briefcase on its back. The '''Golden Body Guard''' wielded a [[wp:Luger pistol|Luger P08]] in its right hand. ==Strategy== *You should not rely too much on the '''Golden Body Guard''' because of its slow spawnrate. *You will need to wait 50 seconds for a '''Golden Body Guard''' to spawn if you place down a [[Golden Crook Boss]] and immediately upgrade it to Level 1. *The '''Golden Body Guard''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with [[defense]], like the [[Giant Boss]]. However, this is not recommended due to the low health of the '''Golden Body Guard'''. **Do note that the '''Golden Body Guard's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]]. *The '''Golden Body Guard''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Golden Body Guard''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Golden Body Guard's''' damage comes primarily from firing at enemies rather than collision. **The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot give the '''Golden Body Guard''' hidden detection. **The '''Golden Body Guard''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]]. *On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Golden Body Guard''' will spawn per Level 1 or 2 [[Golden Crook Boss]]. **Like other units, the '''Golden Body Guard''' will go down a random path. *The '''Golden Body Guard''' will struggle against fast enemies, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into the '''Golden Body Guard''' without taking much damage from its ranged attack. *The '''Golden Body Guard''' is not affected by any buff or debuff as it is a unit. *The '''Golden Body Guard''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units due to its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Golden Body Guard''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed. ==Trivia== *The '''Golden Body Guard''' was duplicated for the Level 3 [[Golden Crook Boss]] [[Units|unit]], the [[Golden Body Guards 1]], though there are minor differences in appearance. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.3]] **{{Bug}} '''Golden Body Guard''' can be damaged by towers that use hitboxes. **{{Bugfix}} '''Golden Body Guard''' now uses the correct name in-game. *'''22 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.3]]b **{{Bugfix}} '''Golden Body Guard''' can no longer be damaged by towers that use hitboxes. **{{Bugfix}} You can no longer collide with the '''Golden Body Guard's''' briefcase. *'''5 August 2022''' -
